children: , the heroes are sponsoring a Podracer in the Ando Overland event, which features 12 racers. Two of the heroes operate a two-seater racing pod, and the other members of the party act as pit crew, spotters, and crew chiefs. The heroes' goal is to secure victory in the three-lap Podrace. This skill challenge is broken into three phases that describe what happens as the race progresses.
The first lap of the race is relatively straightforward.

When the heroes have earned four Successes, move on to Phase 2 of the race.

If the heroes accrue no Failures during the first lap, their racer is in the lead at the end of the lap. If they accrue one or two Failures, their racer is in the middle of the pack at the end of the lap. If they accrue three Failures, their racer crashes, but no one is harmed.

When Phase 2 begins, so does the second lap of the race. As the competition nears its midpoint, the heroes' Pod racer has a chance to make a short pit stop.
